title: Reports say Washington State Lottery's AI website generated an inappropriate image for a user
summary: The Washington State Lottery's AI-powered site reportedly produced an inappropriate image for a user.

title: Reports say the Lavender AI system directed strikes in Gaza with human reviewers acting mostly as rubber stamps
summary: The system reportedly directed strikes with a high rate of civilian casualties, and human review was reportedly largely a formality.

title: Reports say Chinese government-linked groups stepped up AI-generated disinformation aimed at US and Taiwanese voters
summary: Chinese government-linked actors reportedly intensified their use of AI to spread disinformation to voters in the United States and Taiwan.

title: Spain opens the selection procedure for the first director of its AI supervisory agency AESIA
summary: On 8 April 2024 Spain launched the public procedure to choose the first director of the Spanish Agency for the Supervision of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Mistral AI releases open-weight Mixtral 8x22B, first by BitTorrent link and then on Hugging Face
summary: The 141-billion-parameter open-weight model was published through a BitTorrent link on Twitter, followed by a Hugging Face release.

title: US CHIPS Act grants announced for TSMC (USD 6.6bn), Samsung (USD 6.4bn) and Micron (USD 6.1bn)
summary: The grants fund a third TSMC fab in Arizona for the 2 nm process, added Samsung capacity in Texas, and a Micron campus in New York plus a fab in Idaho.

title: Reuters reports Chinese tenders obtained restricted Nvidia chips inside Supermicro and Dell servers
summary: Reuters reportedly found that China obtained banned Nvidia chips and servers from Supermicro and Dell through procurement tenders.

title: Snowflake releases Arctic, an enterprise language model under the Apache 2.0 licence
summary: The newsletter says Snowflake unveiled Arctic a few days after Llama 3, with a reported training cost under USD 2 million.

title: Microsoft announces a USD 1.5 billion investment in Abu Dhabi AI company G42
summary: An FT report dated 16 April 2024 says Microsoft invested USD 1.5 billion in G42 and that Brad Smith joined G42's board.

title: Meta releases Llama 3 in 8B and 70B sizes and launches its Meta AI assistant built on it
summary: Llama 3 was pre-trained on about 15 trillion tokens, and Meta launched the Meta AI assistant alongside it.

title: ABC News reports Meta AI told a Facebook parents' group that it had a child
summary: Some Facebook users were confused after the assistant made the claim in a parents' group, according to ABC News.

title: Deepfake audio falsely depicts Philippine President Marcos Jr. ordering military action
summary: AI-generated audio falsely portrays President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. directing military action.

title: Eight US newspapers sue OpenAI and Microsoft over use of their articles
summary: The suit filed in the Southern District of New York claims the companies illegally harvested copyrighted articles.

title: Japan and US leaders agree at their Washington summit to strengthen cooperation on AI and semiconductors, Jiji reports
summary: Prime Minister Kishida and President Biden's joint documents set out cooperation on AI research, safety and chips.

title: Mumbai Police register an FIR after a deepfake video falsely showing actor Aamir Khan campaigning for a party spreads during India's election
summary: Khan's office said the video was fake and he had never endorsed a party; police registered a case under the IPC and IT Act against an unknown person.

title: Japan's METI and MIC publish version 1.0 of the AI Guidelines for Business for developers, providers and users
summary: The guidelines, compiled after about 3,900 public comments, set voluntary risk-management and governance principles for organisations working with AI.

title: SenseTime releases SenseNova 5.0, which it says performs on par with GPT-4 Turbo on main benchmarks
summary: SenseTime announced the upgraded model family with cloud, edge and on-device versions at its technology day.

title: SK hynix announces KRW 5.3 trillion to build its M15X fab in Cheongju as a production base for HBM AI memory
summary: The company said total investment in the new DRAM fab could exceed KRW 20 trillion over the long term to meet demand for high-bandwidth memory.

title: Shengshu Technology and Tsinghua University unveil Vidu, a text-to-video model generating 16-second clips
summary: Vidu was presented at the Zhongguancun Forum as China's first long-duration video generation model comparable to Sora.
